_ports_comment: ALL of these must answer for the stack to count as up. 43179 is the desktop app's MCP WebSocket (ws://127.0.0.1:43179/mcp) that the human-assist pi extension dials — keeping it here means a green footer genuinely implies the socket HA needs is listening.
_gracePorts_comment: 3614/3615/43179 are bound by the desktop app itself, which restarts on its own (restart_app, single-instance contention). Down for less than the keeper's 20s grace means yellow/partial, not a crash — without this an app bounce spent launch budget and read as a stack crash.
_graceMs_comment: An Electron bounce costs whatever its bundler needs to rebuild and respawn — measured at ~35s here — so the keeper's 20s default would still spend launch budget on a restart we caused ourselves.
